title: Yau's Conjecture on First Eigenvalues
exact_target: Does every closed embedded minimal hypersurface of the unit sphere have first nonzero Laplace eigenvalue equal to its dimension?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1212 (GEO-021). CC BY 4.0.
Lingzhong Zeng, \emph{The First Eigenvalue of Embedded Minimal Hypersurfaces in the Unit Sphere I: Yau\textquotesingle s Conjecture}, arXiv:2508.06123v1 (2025), Section 1, displayed Yau conjecture.
